head: codex/5489-v0917-wp21a-next-milestone-docs
title: [v0.91.7][WP-21A] Prepare v0.91.8 parallel execution plan
body:
Closes #5489

Adds the planned-only v0.91.8 parallel execution plan and reconciles the linked sprint plan, WBS, execution-readiness, and issue-wave surfaces. The plan records the Wave 0 card/readiness factory, global writable-actor WIP cap, single serialized integration/merge queue, WP-10/WP-10A fan-out after WP-09, acceptance-gated cutover/deletion ordering, serialized WP-15 through WP-23 release tail, external-shadow read-only boundaries, and current routing authority through version:v0.91.8 labels plus the checked-in wave file.

Validation: git diff --check; YAML parse with Ruby safe_load; targeted assertions for WP-10A, WP-11, WP-13, WIP controls, and #5343/#5347 sidecar readiness gating; stale-wording scans. Internal exact-revision review found one readiness-factory omission and confirmed it fixed. Fable 5 external shadow review was attempted but unavailable after fail-closed runs and is not recorded as approval. No AWS was used, and no v0.91.8 implementation work was executed.
